title: Create property development and project management application

requirements.text: Create a backend data model for Properties with fields including property name, address, type (residential/commercial/mixed-use), status (planning/development/completed), acquisition date, and estimated completion date
acceptanceCriteria: Property records can be created with all specified fields
Properties can be retrieved, updated, and deleted
Property status can be tracked through development lifecycle

requirements.text: Create a backend data model for Development Projects linked to Properties, with fields including project name, description, budget, start date, target completion date, current phase, and associated property ID
acceptanceCriteria: Projects can be created and linked to specific properties
Project budget and timeline information is stored and retrievable
Projects can be queried by property or status

requirements.text: Create a backend data model for Tasks with fields including task name, description, assigned team member, status (not-started/in-progress/completed), priority (low/medium/high), due date, and associated project ID
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks can be created and linked to projects
Task status and priority can be updated
Tasks can be filtered by status, priority, or assigned member

requirements.text: Create a backend data model for Team Members with fields including name, role, email, and active projects list
acceptanceCriteria: Team members can be created and managed
Team members can be assigned to projects
Active project assignments are tracked per team member

requirements.text: Build a Properties dashboard page that displays all properties in a grid or list view with key information (name, address, type, status, completion date), allows filtering by status and type, and provides add/edit/delete functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Properties are displayed with all key information visible
Users can filter properties by status and type
Users can create new properties, edit existing ones, and delete properties
The interface is responsive and works on desktop and tablet devices

requirements.text: Build a Projects page that displays all development projects with key details (name, property, budget, timeline, phase), allows filtering by status and property, and provides project creation and editing capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Projects are displayed with property association visible
Users can filter projects by status and associated property
Users can create new projects and edit existing ones
Budget and timeline information is clearly presented

requirements.text: Build a Tasks page that displays all tasks organized by project, shows task status and priority with visual indicators, allows filtering by status, priority, and assigned team member, and provides task creation, editing, and status updates
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks are organized by their associated projects
Status and priority are visually distinct (colors, badges, or icons)
Users can filter tasks by multiple criteria simultaneously
Users can create tasks, update task details, and change task status

requirements.text: Build a Team page that displays all team members with their roles, shows active project assignments for each member, and provides team member management capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Team members are displayed with role and contact information
Active project assignments are visible for each team member
Users can add new team members and edit existing member details

requirements.text: Create a navigation system that allows users to move between Properties, Projects, Tasks, and Team pages with clear indication of the current page
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation menu is accessible from all pages
Current page is visually highlighted in navigation
Navigation works consistently across all views

requirements.text: Design a professional, modern visual theme for the application with a cohesive color palette suitable for business/corporate use, clear typography hierarchy, consistent spacing and layout patterns, and a polished, trustworthy appearance that conveys expertise in property development and project management
acceptanceCriteria: All pages follow a consistent visual theme
Color palette is professional and not overwhelming
Typography is readable and establishes clear hierarchy
Layout patterns are consistent across all sections

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend paths (useInternetIdentity, useActor, main.tsx, ui components)
Use React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and React Query for frontend

required: Professional hero background image showing modern property development or construction with clean, corporate aesthetic (hero-background.dim_1920x600.png)
Simple property icon representing buildings or real estate in a minimalist style (property-icon.dim_64x64.png)
Simple project management icon representing planning or coordination in a minimalist style (project-icon.dim_64x64.png)
